lake-constance-appenzell-s-ntis-view-loo.title: Lake Constance · Appenzell · Säntis View Loop
lake-constance-appenzell-s-ntis-view-loo.slogan: A 192 km loop out of Rorschach lakefront
lake-constance-appenzell-s-ntis-view-loo.story: Water first, green hills later, with a proper alpine silhouette. Out of Rorschach and back again: 192 km, roughly 3 h 42 in the saddle. The stops in between: Appenzell and Säntis view road. The climb of the day is Schwägalp road. It tops out at 1,278 m. The passes are the reason to go.

sections.advice: Appenzell lunch → Säntis view road is the reward section in Schwägalp. Look through the bends, use legal pull-offs for photos and keep a little margin for tractors, cyclists and damp shade. The best ride here is smooth, not noisy.

sections.advice: This Säntis view road → Schwägalp road stretch is for rhythm and scenery. Keep your head up, let the view breathe, and resist turning every open bend into a target. Stop once properly rather than half-stopping everywhere.

scenicChapters.title: Grand Tour of Switzerland
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 58 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

scenicChapters.title: Grand Tour of Switzerland
scenicChapters.narrative: The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 34 km. 420 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall — a steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Grand Tour of Switzerland
scenicChapters.narrative: For 8 km this is Grand Tour of Switzerland, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it. Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Grand Tour of Switzerland
scenicChapters.narrative: This is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else. 92 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it.
